boxes.description: Two separate islands of 32 boxes: 4 wide x 2 deep x 4 high each. The islands are 12 m apart, so waking one cannot physically touch the other.

recorded.notes: All values are Node measurements from this fixture, not targets. sleepTick is 1-based: the first step after which all 64 bodies report sleeping. driftM is the maximum per-body position change over the 600 ticks after settling; the overlay zeroes the gravity scale while asleep, so the measured value is exactly 0. wakeHash is taken one step after the impulse; finalHash 120 ticks later. Boxes are created in island, row, depth, column order.
